data.title: Ku-0063794 is a specific inhibitor of the mammalian target of rapamycin (mTOR)
data.authors: Garcia-Martinez JM; Alessi DR et al.

evidence.label: Molecular — cells, biochemistry, structure
evidence.note: this describes the kind of study, not its quality

data.finding: Ku-0063794 is a specific ATP-competitive mTOR inhibitor blocking mTORC1 and mTORC2.
data.abstract_excerpt: mTOR (mammalian target of rapamycin) stimulates cell growth by phosphorylating and promoting activation of AGC family kinases such as Akt (protein kinase B), S6K (p70 ribosomal S6 kinase) and SGK (serum and glucocorticoid protein kinase). mTORC1 phosphorylates the hydrophobic motif of S6K, whereas mTORC2 phosphorylates the hydrophobic motif of Akt and SGK.

extracted_findings.effect: Ku-0063794 is a specific mTOR inhibitor blocking both complexes (Akt/S6K/SGK signaling)
